angle: Far under and still going. The body stops reporting in: no sense of the hands, no sense of how long it has been. The voice arrives and nothing answers it.
Absorption without effort. Thought thinned to one slow thing at a time, the descent carrying itself, no floor felt yet and no wish to find one.
The floor of the descent. Nothing left holding itself up, awareness down to one thread, no interest at all in coming back up.
Surfaced and holding. Eyes open, the room solid, and what settled during the session staying put through the ordinary hours instead of fading at the door.
Fully back with the change durable underfoot. Standing, moving, steady and clear, carrying it into the day without effort.
Completely restored and bright. Full alertness, full presence, the whole body awake and the change carried forward under its own power.
